occupation.name: Teaching Assistant for Business Process Management Course
occupation.description: Supervision of BPM automation projects and server administration.
responsibilities: Provided guidance and supervision to a teaching assistant regarding server administration and business process automation implementation.
Guided students in the successful execution of their business process automation projects.
Reviewed student automation models for alignment with coursework requirements and guided corrections where models diverged.
Monitored the multi-instance ProcessMaker VPS during the teaching term, keeping student environments available for project work.
Coordinated server maintenance duties with the supervised teaching assistant so instance issues were resolved without disrupting classes.
